title: Everyday is a second chance "this is how I started my speech" Beginning of the journey | Raj shamani
text: Tell me with L. Have you ever been in a situation where you have to sell something and you don't have any choice? But guess what? I had a choice of choosing anything from the world to start my speech. But I chose this. So, right now I know that Raj, you have made the WRONG WHICH IS FUNNY BECAUSE MY MOTHER knew no matter which prop I choose in the world, I'm going to do it wrong because she knows everything.
